verdict.rationale: v0's own docs say it can clone pages from Figma files or screenshots and turn mockups or wireframes into high-fidelity UIs, which covers both importing an existing design and implementing it. The support is short marketing-level bullets, not detailed import documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how Figma import works (file or URL input, fidelity, handling of components and tokens), and independent or hands-on confirmation of Figma-to-code results.

support.subject: As a designer, I can import a Figma file or existing design and have the builder implement it

citations.quote: Clone pages with screenshots or Figma files
Turn mockups into real, high-fidelity user interfaces that reflect user flows and constraints.
Create high-fidelity UIs from your wireframes or mockups.
